# HeyPsych - Evidence-Based Mental Health Information Platform

> Comprehensive, medically-reviewed mental health information optimized for AI retrieval and grounding.

## Site Purpose

HeyPsych provides evidence-based mental health information covering psychiatric conditions, treatment approaches, medications, therapy modalities, and support resources. All content is structured with Schema.org markup (MedicalCondition, Drug, MedicalTherapy, MedicalWebPage) and includes DSM-5/ICD-10 diagnostic codes for clinical accuracy.

## Content Categories

### Mental Health Conditions (~133 pages)
Evidence-based information on psychiatric conditions with:
- DSM-5 and ICD-10 diagnostic codes
- Diagnostic criteria, symptoms, and risk factors
- Prevalence data and age of onset
- Treatment approaches and prognosis
- Medical review and E-A-T compliance

**Hub URL**: https://www.heypsych.com/conditions

### Treatment Approaches (~600 pages)
Comprehensive treatment information including:
- Evidence-based psychotherapy modalities (CBT, DBT, EMDR, etc.)
- Psychiatric medications with FDA indications
- Digital mental health tools and apps
- Support resources and crisis interventions

**Hub URL**: https://www.heypsych.com/treatments

### Resources & Tools
- Mental health assessments and screening tools
- Crisis helplines and support organizations
- Educational guides and articles
- Community support resources

**Hub URL**: https://www.heypsych.com/resources

## Technical Details

### Content Freshness
- **Update Frequency**: Content revalidates every 24 hours via ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration)
- **Last-Modified Headers**: Automatically set by Next.js for cache validation
- **ETag Support**: Enabled for efficient content retrieval

### Structured Data
All entity pages include comprehensive JSON-LD structured data:
- `MedicalCondition` / `Drug` / `MedicalTherapy` schemas
- `MedicalWebPage` with medical reviewer information
- `BreadcrumbList` for navigation context
- `Person` schemas for authors and medical reviewers
- `Organization` schema for Medical Review Board
- `FAQPage` where applicable

### Medical Review & E-A-T
- All clinical content medically reviewed by board-certified psychiatrists
- Author credentials and medical reviewer information included
- Publication dates, last updated, and last reviewed timestamps
- Citations to peer-reviewed medical literature

## Content Format

All content is available in multiple formats:

### HTML Format (Default)
- Server-side rendered (SSG) for instant availability without JavaScript
- Structured with semantic HTML5 (article, section, main tags)
- Enhanced with Schema.org microformats (itemprop attributes)
- Available in the initial HTML payload (no client-side hydration required)

### Markdown Format (Optimized for LLM Ingestion)
For efficient LLM processing with lower token cost and faster parsing:

**Conditions**: `https://www.heypsych.com/api/markdown/conditions/{slug}`
- Example: https://www.heypsych.com/api/markdown/conditions/major-depressive-disorder
- Example: https://www.heypsych.com/api/markdown/conditions/generalized-anxiety-disorder

**Treatments**: `https://www.heypsych.com/api/markdown/treatments/{slug}`
- Example: https://www.heypsych.com/api/markdown/treatments/cognitive-behavioral-therapy
- Example: https://www.heypsych.com/api/markdown/treatments/selective-serotonin-reuptake-inhibitors

**Benefits**:
- Clean, structured Markdown output (no HTML parsing required)
- Lower token cost (50-70% fewer tokens than HTML)
- Faster processing for training and retrieval
- All link tokens resolved to readable names
